sentences.text: 4. The aforesaid complaint was lodged by the Headmaster of the school against the Secretary of the school and others.
5. The appellant is the supplier of stone-chips.

6. It appears that the other accused persons of this case had approached this Court vide Cr. Misc.
No. 2392 of 2021 with a prayer for setting aside the order refusing to grant bail to them.
This Court vide order dated 06.09.2021, after hearing the aforesaid appellants and the learned Special Public Prosecutor for the State, granted bail to those persons.
Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.2991 of 2024(3) dt.10-01-2025 7.

Let notice be issued to the informant /respondent no. 2 by both modes i.e., under ordinary process as well as registered cover with AD, on steps being taken by the appellant for filing requisites etc. within a period of two weeks from today, returnable on 21st of March, 2025.
8.

In the mean time, the appellant, above named, is directed to be released on provisional bail on his furnishing bonds in the sum of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge- cum-Special Court, SC/ST Munger in connection with SC/ST P.S. Case No. 09/2013.
